# Team Synf

> Team Synf — student-led creative collective based in Hyderabad, India. Parties, nightlife, DJ nights, music events and curated experiences. We don't do ordinary.

## About

Team Synf is a student-led collective organizing nightlife experiences, DJ nights, and curated cultural events across Hyderabad. The collective brings together DJs, artists, photographers, and creatives to produce parties and events that push the culture forward.
